title: Cola for Breakfast?
setting: A family house: a bathroom upstairs and a kitchen downstairs.

characters.name: Ben
characters.look: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts)

characters.name: Anna
characters.look: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan)

sentences.en: Ben wakes up early and looks at the clock.
sentences.zh: 本很早就醒了，看了看时钟。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) sits up in bed and looks at a round clock on the wall, pale early morning light outside.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben waking and looking at the clock; 'early' is only hinted by the light.
sentences.narration: Ben sits up in bed and looks at a round clock on the wall, pale early morning light outside.

sentence_targets.en: Near the beginning of a period or before the usual time
a device that shows the time

sentences.en: He takes a warm shower and washes his head.
sentences.zh: 他洗了个热水澡，还洗了头。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts), seen from the shoulders up behind a shower curtain, washes his hair with soap foam under a warm shower.
sentences.narration: Ben, seen from the shoulders up behind a shower curtain, washes his hair with soap foam under a warm shower.

sentence_targets.en: the body part containing the brain, eyes, and mouth
Washing under falling water, or the equipment used for this

sentences.en: Then he runs downstairs to the kitchen.
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) runs down the stairs toward the kitchen.
sentences.narration: Ben runs down the stairs toward the kitchen.

sentence_targets.en: On or towards a lower floor of a building

sentences.en: "Hey, Ben, your meal is ready!" says Mum.
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) calls and waves to Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) from a kitchen table with breakfast on it.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Mum calling Ben to a ready breakfast; her exact words can't be shown.
sentences.narration: Anna calls and waves to Ben from a kitchen table with breakfast on it.

sentence_targets.en: Used informally to greet someone or attract their attention.
An occasion when you eat, or the food eaten then.

sentences.en: Their grey pet cat sleeps on a chair.
sentences.zh: 他们家的灰色宠物猫睡在一把椅子上。
sentences.scene_prompt: A grey cat sleeps on a kitchen chair next to Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan).
sentences.narration: A grey cat sleeps on a kitchen chair next to Anna.

sentence_targets.en: Having a colour between black and white.
a seat for one person, usually with a back

sentences.en: Ben is not interested in these eggs.
sentences.zh: 本对这些鸡蛋不感兴趣。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) looks bored and pushes away a plate of eggs on the table.
sentences.narration: Ben looks bored and pushes away a plate of eggs on the table.

sentence_targets.en: Used before plural nouns for nearby people or things.
Wanting to learn about or take part in something.

sentences.en: He wants something else: cola, his favourite drink.
sentences.zh: 他想要别的东西：可乐，他最喜欢的饮料。
sentences.scene_prompt: Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts) reaches eagerly for a bottle of cola on the table.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Ben reaching for cola; 'favourite' can't be shown.
sentences.narration: Ben reaches eagerly for a bottle of cola on the table.

sentence_targets.en: A thing that is not named or specified.
A sweet, dark, fizzy drink, usually containing caffeine.
liked more than any other of the same kind

sentences.en: Mum says he can have some, but not much.
sentences.zh: 妈妈说他可以喝一点，但不能喝很多。
sentences.scene_prompt: Anna (a woman of about forty with shoulder-length red hair, round glasses and a teal cardigan) pours a little cola into a small glass for Ben (a ten-year-old boy with curly red hair, freckles, a green T-shirt and blue shorts).
sentences.draw_note: Shows Mum pouring a little cola; what she says is only hinted.
sentences.narration: Anna pours a little cola into a small glass for Ben.

sentence_targets.en: A large amount of something, used with uncountable nouns.
Used to express ability, permission, or possibility.
